HIA implementations replace the live Python authorities rather than call through to them
arbitrary identifiers, module graph, linking and a real standalone CLI
source-only B0/B1/B2/B3 and modified-source fixed points for the full toolchain

components.boundary: HIA scanner/parser supports general ASCII module/function/SSA/formal/block identifiers and arbitrary entry declaration order in the bounded assembly profile. Explicitly selected HIA syntax preflight, JSON value-arena decoding and wire canonicalization are integrated into existing inputs; foreign-object bridging, caller-owned object serialization and the default reference remain Python. Module graphs, full frontend grammar and whole-runtime replacement remain open.

Native fixed-profile checks exist; composite elaboration and general result signatures remain open; bounded scalar/owner/parameter-bound loan tuples are implemented and require current-source qualification.

A bounded one-shot SHA-256 algorithm is implemented in HIA and can be explicitly selected for Core content digests; host code-custody hashing remains. Core reference interpretation, general runtime/task/I/O and the complete production library remain open.
HIA writes bounded Linux x86-64 flat/ELF images; general linking, multiple exports and other native targets remain Python/external tools.
Module graphs, package locks, build orchestration and the complete frontend pipeline remain Python.
The real Agent worker/service, durable tools and protocol orchestration remain Python.
Planning/optimization/translation validation and proof construction are not rewritten; finite proof scopes do not establish whole compiler refinement.

A bounded Linux stdin/stdout compiler ET_EXEC entry is authored in HIA and requires current-source qualification; production CLI, installation/materialization/release tools and whole clean-machine toolchain remain open.

metadata.evidence_kind: static inventory and explicit implementation boundary, not execution evidence
limits: AST imports do not enumerate dynamic imports or prove dependency closure
line counts do not measure semantic completion
a byte fixed point proves only the declared compiler subset's observed self-reproduction
external OS, ABI, allocator and linker dependencies must stay explicit
historical or adjacent-branch CI does not qualify changed source bytes

reconstruction: Take base path-indexed lists; remove listed paths; replace/add rows; sort by path; insert lists into metadata at the named field. JSON indent2/sort_keys with final newline reconstructs exact report bytes.
